ci.bounds: the wider of the cluster bootstrap and the item-level Wilson interval

example_line: org prompt "... The chart on the ankle is kept in the gold folder. ... The chart on the brain is kept in the grey folder. ... The chart on the heart is kept in the purple folder. ... Which colour is the folder that holds the chart on the body part that does the thinking?" -> answer org grey; the alt prompt asks about the ankle (bridge alt), its 12th statement. Possible answers after the patch: gold (answer of bridge alt's statement), purple (answer at the same statement slot), pink (the alt prompt's own answer), grey (answer org kept).
